descripcion: Large railway and coach stations, platforms with the train standing, underground, tram, airport (check-in, security, gates and baggage reclaim) and harbour, with their landmarks, sounds and warnings.

mostrador_info_estacion.nombre: Station information desk with low section
mostrador_info_estacion.descripcion: Long passenger information desk. On the right is a low section with knee space and a hearing loop: you are served there seated or in a wheelchair.
mostrador_info_estacion.imagen: Footprint of “Station information desk with low section”: a rectangle whose right-hand section sticks out less: the low section, with knee space, 3.60 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Mi”.

punto_asistencia_estacion.descripcion: Totem of the assistance service for disabled passengers: a wide column with a call button at hand height and a braille label. Staff meet you here to take you to the train.
punto_asistencia_estacion.imagen: Footprint of “Passenger assistance meeting point”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

zona_espera_asistencia.descripcion: A patch of different paving next to the assistance point: you feel it with your foot and cane. It is where to wait so that staff can see you.
zona_espera_asistencia.imagen: Footprint of “Marked assistance waiting area”: a rectangle, 2.50 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ze”.

interfono_asistencia_pared.descripcion: Box with a speaker and a large button, fixed to the wall at chest height. It sticks out a hand's width and the cane passes under it.
interfono_asistencia_pared.imagen: Footprint of “Wall-mounted assistance intercom”: a rectangle, 0.25 by 0.10 metres, hanging 0.90 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ia”.

totem_info_audio.descripcion: Column with a touch screen, raised keys and a braille button: press it and it reads out the departures and platforms.
totem_info_audio.imagen: Footprint of “Accessible information totem with audio”: a rectangle with cut corners, 0.60 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ti”.

panel_salidas_colgado.descripcion: Huge board hung from the ceiling in the middle of the concourse. It is far above head height and not in the way; people stop beneath it to look, so expect clusters.
panel_salidas_colgado.imagen: Footprint of “Hanging departures and arrivals board”: a rectangle, 5.00 by 0.30 metres, hanging 2.60 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ps”.

ventanillas_bateria.nombre: Bank of ticket windows with dividers
ventanillas_bateria.descripcion: Several ticket windows side by side in a wall. A chest-high divider sticks out between them; each window has its own ledge and glass.
ventanillas_bateria.imagen: Footprint of “Bank of ticket windows with dividers”: a comb: a bar with bodies sticking out to the front, 4.80 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Vb”.

autoventa_bateria.descripcion: Several ticket machines side by side against the wall. Each has a speech button that reads the screen; the keys beep.
autoventa_bateria.imagen: Footprint of “Bank of talking ticket machines”: a rectangle, 2.40 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Ab”.

consigna_automatica.nombre: Automatic left-luggage lockers with pay terminal
consigna_automatica.descripcion: Bank of large lockers with a terminal in the middle. You pay at the terminal, it beeps and one locker door springs open: find it by hand.
consigna_automatica.imagen: Footprint of “Automatic left-luggage lockers with pay terminal”: a rectangle, 2.70 by 0.85 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

asiento_reservado_estacion.descripcion: Wide seat at the end of a row, with high armrests to help you stand and a free space beside it for a wheelchair or guide dog.
asiento_reservado_estacion.imagen: Footprint of “Priority seat in a station”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.65 metres, marked with the letters “Ar”.

banco_circular_columna.descripcion: Continuous bench running round a concourse column. You can walk all the way round; seated, your back is to the column and you face the passers-by.
banco_circular_columna.imagen: Footprint of “Circular bench round a column”: a circle, 2.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

columna_carga_moviles.descripcion: Post with sockets and a round shelf at elbow height for your phone. There are usually people standing round it.
columna_carga_moviles.imagen: Footprint of “Phone charging post”: a circle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

carros_encajados_monedero.nombre: Nested luggage trolleys with coin lock
carros_encajados_monedero.descripcion: A line of luggage trolleys pushed into one another and chained. To release one you put a coin in the lock on the handle.
carros_encajados_monedero.imagen: Footprint of “Nested luggage trolleys with coin lock”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 3.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ce”.

quiosco_isla_vestibulo.descripcion: Newspaper and sweet kiosk in the middle of the concourse, open on every side. Display racks stick out at the corners: go round it with care.
quiosco_isla_vestibulo.imagen: Footprint of “Concourse island kiosk”: a hexagon, 3.00 by 2.60 metres, marked with the letters “Qi”.

tienda_conveniencia_abierta.descripcion: Shop with no door or window: three walls of shelves and a completely open front. You walk in without noticing; inside, the drinks fridge hums.
tienda_conveniencia_abierta.imagen: Footprint of “Open-fronted convenience shop”: a U open at the front, 4.50 by 3.50 metres, marked with the letters “Tc”.

reloj_punto_encuentro.descripcion: Large clock on a pedestal in the centre of the concourse: the time-honoured meeting place. Its loud tick carries a long way and helps you get your bearings.
reloj_punto_encuentro.imagen: Footprint of “Monumental station clock”: an octagon, 1.20 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Rp”.

escaner_equipajes_estacion.descripcion: Compact machine with a belt that takes your case in at one end and returns it at the other. It hums constantly. You walk alongside and collect your case at the far end.

acciones.dejar_bandeja: Put your things in a tray

escaner_equipajes_estacion.imagen: Footprint of “Baggage scanner for high-speed trains”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 3.20 metres, marked with the letters “Ee”.

atril_control_billetes.descripcion: Narrow lectern where a member of staff scans your ticket with a reader that beeps. It stands right before the platform access, with a queue in front.
atril_control_billetes.imagen: Footprint of “Boarding ticket check lectern”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.60 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ac”.

borde_anden_antiguo.nombre: Old platform edge with no tactile strip
borde_anden_antiguo.descripcion: Stone platform edge with no warning blisters: just a row of smoother slabs. Beyond it the ground ends and the tracks begin.
borde_anden_antiguo.aviso: Platform edge with no warning strip: stop. The tracks are beyond.
borde_anden_antiguo.imagen: Footprint of “Old platform edge with no tactile strip”: a rectangle, 10.00 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ba”.

hueco_coche_anden.descripcion: Narrow, deep gap between the platform edge and the train step. A foot or the tip of a cane fits in it: take a long step.
hueco_coche_anden.aviso: Mind the gap between the train and the platform.
hueco_coche_anden.imagen: Footprint of “Gap between train and platform”: a rectangle, 1.30 by 0.15 metres, marked with the letters “Hc”.

marca_puerta_anden.descripcion: A patch of raised bars on the platform floor: it marks where the accessible train door stops. Wait on it.
marca_puerta_anden.imagen: Footprint of “Tactile door position marker”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Mp”.

manguera_aguada_anden.descripcion: Thick hose running across the platform to the train to fill it with water. It is low and soft: it catches your foot, or the cane rolls over it.
manguera_aguada_anden.aviso: Hose on the ground: lift your feet.
manguera_aguada_anden.imagen: Footprint of “Hose lying across the platform”: a rectangle, 0.08 by 4.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

refugio_acristalado_anden.descripcion: Glass cabin in the middle of the platform, with a bench inside and the entrance at the front. Inside there is no wind and the train sounds quieter.
refugio_acristalado_anden.imagen: Footprint of “Glazed platform waiting shelter”: a U open at the front, 5.00 by 2.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ra”.

marquesina_anden_columnas.descripcion: High roof along the platform. It is not in the way but you notice it: no rain underneath, and sounds echo. Its columns, in a row, are obstacles.
marquesina_anden_columnas.imagen: Footprint of “Platform canopy on columns”: a rectangle, 10.00 by 4.00 metres, hanging 3.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ma”.

tablon_horario_voladizo.descripcion: Timetable case hung on the wall at chest height. It sticks out a hand's width and does not reach the floor: the cane passes under it.
tablon_horario_voladizo.imagen: Footprint of “Projecting platform timetable case”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.12 metres, hanging 0.90 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Th”.

cartel_nombre_estacion.nombre: Station name board on two posts
cartel_nombre_estacion.descripcion: Long board with the station name, held between two thin posts. The cane finds the posts; the board spans between them at face height.
cartel_nombre_estacion.imagen: Footprint of “Station name board on two posts”: a rectangle, 2.50 by 0.10 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Cn”.

coche_tren_tramo.descripcion: Side of a train coach standing at the platform: a long sheet-metal wall that hums. Follow it by hand until you find a door. Place several sections in a row to make the train.
coche_tren_tramo.imagen: Footprint of “Standing train coach (section)”: a rectangle, 6.00 by 2.90 metres, marked with the letters “Ct”.

cabeza_tren.descripcion: The end of the train: the side curves in and ends in a nose. It is louder than the coaches. Beyond the nose there is no train, only track.
cabeza_tren.imagen: Footprint of “Standing train nose or locomotive”: a long body with a tapered nose on the left, 6.00 by 2.90 metres, marked with the letters “Ct”.

puerta_tren_abierta.descripcion: Door opening in the side of the train. There is a button at hand height: press it, it beeps and the leaves open. There is a step, and a gap from the platform.
puerta_tren_abierta.aviso: Train door: there is a step and a gap from the platform.
puerta_tren_abierta.imagen: Footprint of “Train door with step”: a rectangle, 1.30 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Pt”.

fuelle_tren.descripcion: The join between two coaches: a rubber bellows narrower than the train, with gaps at the sides opening onto the track. It feels like a door and is NOT one: carry on until you feel smooth metal.
fuelle_tren.aviso: Join between two coaches: not a door, there is a gap down to the track.
fuelle_tren.imagen: Footprint of “Gangway bellows between coaches”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.80 by 2.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ft”.

rampa_embarque_movil.descripcion: Metal ramp that staff lay between the platform and the train door. It sounds hollow underfoot and has a raised lip on each side.
rampa_embarque_movil.aviso: Boarding ramp: it rises to the train door.
rampa_embarque_movil.imagen: Footprint of “Portable boarding ramp”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “Re”.

plataforma_elevadora_embarque.descripcion: Metal cart with a cage and a crank, parked on the platform and chained to a column. It lifts a wheelchair up to the train. It is hard and has corners.
plataforma_elevadora_embarque.imagen: Footprint of “Wheelchair boarding lift”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 1.60 metres, marked with the letters “Pe”.

carro_restauracion_anden.descripcion: Tall wheeled container full of trays, waiting by the train to be loaded. Here today and gone tomorrow; it rattles when touched.
carro_restauracion_anden.imagen: Footprint of “Catering cart on the platform”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 1.10 metres, marked with the letters “Cr”.

carro_limpieza_trenes.descripcion: Cart with buckets, bags and a mop handle sticking up. It is left on the platform while the train is cleaned; the floor round it may be wet.
carro_limpieza_trenes.imagen: Footprint of “Train cleaning cart”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 1.10 metres, marked with the letters “Cl”.

tope_via.descripcion: Solid block with two buffers at the end of the track in a terminus. It marks the head of the platform: behind it you can cross from one platform to another.
tope_via.imagen: Footprint of “Buffer stop”: a T shape, 2.50 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Tv”.

caja_via.descripcion: The track bed: a pit of loose stones, sleepers and rails more than a metre below the platform. Never step into it. Use it to mark where the danger is.
caja_via.aviso: You are on the track! No-go area: get back on the platform.
caja_via.imagen: Footprint of “Railway track: no-go area”: a rectangle, 10.00 by 2.80 metres, marked with the letters “Cv”.

paso_entre_andenes.descripcion: Rubber or wooden deck crossing the tracks level with the rails, in small stations. It sounds different underfoot. Cross straight over, and only if the signal is silent.
paso_entre_andenes.aviso: Platform crossing: go straight over, and only if the bell is not ringing.
paso_entre_andenes.imagen: Footprint of “Level crossing between platforms”: a rectangle, 2.50 by 5.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pe”.

barrera_paso_andenes.nombre: Platform crossing barrier with audible signal
barrera_paso_andenes.descripcion: Waist-high barrier at the start of the platform crossing. When a train is coming it lowers and a bell rings; when it falls silent and lifts, you may cross.
barrera_paso_andenes.imagen: Footprint of “Platform crossing barrier with audible signal”: a rectangle, 2.50 by 0.20 metres, marked with the letters “Bp”.

cancela_fin_anden.descripcion: Barred gate closing off the end of the platform. Behind it a ramp goes down to the tracks, for staff only: turn back here.
cancela_fin_anden.aviso: End of the platform: go no further, turn back.
cancela_fin_anden.imagen: Footprint of “End-of-platform gate”: a rectangle, 2.50 by 0.08 metres, marked with the letters “Cf”.

cancela_boca_metro.descripcion: Grille that closes the underground entrance when there is no service. Closed, it is a wall of bars at the top of the stairs; open, it is folded to one side.
cancela_boca_metro.imagen: Footprint of “Underground entrance gate”: a rectangle, 2.50 by 0.10 metres, marked with the letters “Cb”.

barandilla_boca_metro.descripcion: U-shaped railing round the underground stairwell in the pavement. It bars the way on three sides; on the open side the stairs start, going down.
barandilla_boca_metro.imagen: Footprint of “Underground entrance railing”: a U open at the front, 2.50 by 5.00 metres, marked with the letters “Bb”.

templete_boca_metro.descripcion: Roofed glass cabin covering the underground stairs. Three smooth glass walls and one open side where you go down.
templete_boca_metro.imagen: Footprint of “Glazed underground entrance canopy”: a U open at the front, 3.00 by 6.00 metres, marked with the letters “Tb”.

poste_boca_metro.descripcion: Tall post beside the underground entrance, with the network's diamond on top. Thicker than a road sign; it tells you the stairs are right beside it.
poste_boca_metro.imagen: Footprint of “Underground entrance sign post”: a hexagon, 0.20 by 0.20 metres, marked with the letters “Pb”.

puertas_cortavientos_metro.descripcion: Pair of heavy two-way swing doors in an underground passage. Push them with your body and they swing back hard: mind whoever is behind you, and the returning leaf.
puertas_cortavientos_metro.imagen: Footprint of “Underground draught swing doors”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 0.08 metres, marked with the letters “Pc”.

paso_hojas_cristal.descripcion: Narrow passage between two metal bodies, closed by two chest-high glass leaves. Validate, it beeps and the leaves part for a moment: go through without stopping.
paso_hojas_cristal.imagen: Footprint of “Glass-leaf ticket gate”: two narrow bodies at the sides and, between them, thin leaves barring the way, 0.85 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ph”.

torno_salida_jaula.descripcion: Barred turnstile from floor to above head height, like a cage. It only turns outwards: push with your body and it ratchets. Large cases do not fit.
torno_salida_jaula.imagen: Footprint of “Full-height exit turnstile”: a cross, 1.50 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ts”.

cabina_agente_metro.descripcion: Glass booth beside the gates, with a person inside. It has a window with a speech grille at face height; go round it at the sides.
cabina_agente_metro.imagen: Footprint of “Station agent's booth”: a rectangle with cut corners, 2.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

puertas_anden_cristal.descripcion: Glass wall along the platform edge, with doors that open only when the train has stopped behind it. It beeps before opening and closing. Closed, it keeps you off the track.
puertas_anden_cristal.imagen: Footprint of “Automatic glass platform screen doors (section)”: a rectangle, 4.00 by 0.25 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

panel_proximo_tren.descripcion: Display hung from the platform ceiling, above head height. Every so often it announces how long until the next train and where it is going.
panel_proximo_tren.imagen: Footprint of “Talking next-train display”: a rectangle, 1.40 by 0.20 metres, hanging 2.30 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pp”.

espejo_anden.descripcion: Large convex mirror on an arm projecting from the wall at the head of the platform, so the driver can see the doors. It is at head height.
espejo_anden.imagen: Footprint of “Platform mirror”: an oval, 0.80 by 0.50 metres, hanging 1.60 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ea”.

asiento_abatible_anden.descripcion: Row of narrow seats bolted to the wall, with no legs. The cane passes underneath and gives no warning: you find them with your knee.
asiento_abatible_anden.imagen: Footprint of “Wall-mounted tip-up platform seat”: a rectangle, 1.40 by 0.40 metres, hanging 0.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Aa”.

plano_red_relieve.descripcion: Wall panel with the network lines raised and the stations in braille. Read it with both hands, standing; it sticks out very little.
plano_red_relieve.imagen: Footprint of “Raised network map”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.06 metres, hanging 0.90 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pr”.

recarga_tarjetas_pared.descripcion: Small terminal hung on the wall at chest height, to top up your travel card. It does not reach the floor: the cane will not find it.
recarga_tarjetas_pared.imagen: Footprint of “Wall-mounted card top-up machine”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.30 metres, hanging 0.80 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Rt”.

anden_tranvia_bajo.descripcion: Platform a hand's width higher than the street, long and narrow. You get on by a ramp at each end; the track side has a kerb.
anden_tranvia_bajo.aviso: Tram platform: there is a kerb on the track side.
anden_tranvia_bajo.imagen: Footprint of “Low tram stop platform”: a rectangle, 20.00 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “At”.

rail_tranvia_embebido.nombre: Tram rail set into the ground
rail_tranvia_embebido.descripcion: Steel rail flush with the ground, with a groove. It is slippery when wet, and the groove traps the cane tip and small wheels: cross it square on.
rail_tranvia_embebido.aviso: Tram rail: slippery, and it traps the cane.
rail_tranvia_embebido.imagen: Footprint of “Tram rail set into the ground”: a rectangle, 0.10 by 10.00 metres, marked with the letters “Rt”.

poste_catenaria.descripcion: Thick, sharp-edged steel mast carrying the tram or railway wires. There is one every thirty paces, always the same distance from the track.
poste_catenaria.imagen: Footprint of “Overhead line mast”: a rectangle, 0.30 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Pc”.

chicane_paso_tranvia.nombre: Staggered barriers at a tram crossing
chicane_paso_tranvia.descripcion: Two staggered railings before the tram tracks: they make you turn twice so nobody crosses without looking. Follow the first by hand, turn, and follow the second.
chicane_paso_tranvia.imagen: Footprint of “Staggered barriers at a tram crossing”: a Z: two staggered railings that make you turn twice, 2.50 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

darsena_autobuses.descripcion: The bay where the coach parks, set diagonally and lower than the waiting pavement. Coaches reverse here: do not step into it except to board.
darsena_autobuses.aviso: Coach bay: buses manoeuvre here. Go back to the pavement.
darsena_autobuses.imagen: Footprint of “Coach station bay”: a parallelogram: the bus bay set diagonally, saw-tooth fashion, 3.50 by 12.00 metres, marked with the letters “Da”.

pilonas_cadena_darsena.descripcion: Row of short, stout posts at the head of the bay, with a chain slung between them at knee height. It is the chain that trips you.
pilonas_cadena_darsena.imagen: Footprint of “Bay bollards linked by chain”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.20 metres, marked with the letters “Pc”.

poste_darsena_braille.nombre: Bay post with raised and braille number
poste_darsena_braille.descripcion: Square post at the head of each bay. At hand height it has a plate with the bay number raised and in braille.
poste_darsena_braille.imagen: Footprint of “Bay post with raised and braille number”: a rectangle, 0.12 by 0.12 metres, marked with the letters “Pd”.

mostrador_facturacion.descripcion: High desk with a person behind it. Beside it, almost at floor level, is the scale where you put your case. There are many identical ones in a row.
mostrador_facturacion.imagen: Footprint of “Check-in desk”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Mf”.

bascula_cinta_facturacion.descripcion: Low rubber belt between two desks, at ankle height: easy to trip over. You put your case on it; the weight beeps and the belt carries it away.

acciones.facturar_maleta: Put your suitcase on the scale

bascula_cinta_facturacion.imagen: Footprint of “Check-in scale and belt”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

quiosco_autofacturacion.descripcion: Column with a sloping screen at chest height and a slot where the boarding pass comes out. There are usually several together, in a cluster.
quiosco_autofacturacion.imagen: Footprint of “Self check-in kiosk”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.60 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Qa”.

entrega_automatica_equipaje.descripcion: A post with a reader and, attached to it, a low belt inside a box open at the front. Put your case down, scan the tag and the belt swallows it.

acciones.facturar_maleta: Put your suitcase on the scale

entrega_automatica_equipaje.imagen: Footprint of “Self-service bag drop”: an L shape, 1.50 by 2.20 metres, marked with the letters “Ea”.

medidor_equipaje_mano.descripcion: Hip-high cage of metal tubes, open at the top: you drop your bag in to see if it fits. It stands loose, in the way on the approach to the queue.
medidor_equipaje_mano.imagen: Footprint of “Cabin bag sizer”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Me”.

embaladora_maletas.descripcion: Low turntable with a column beside it that wraps your case in plastic film. The turntable is at ankle height and spins while working.
embaladora_maletas.imagen: Footprint of “Suitcase wrapping machine”: an octagon, 1.50 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Em”.

cola_zigzag_cintas.descripcion: Maze of lanes made of low posts joined by fabric belt. The belt is at waist height, gives when touched, and the cane passes under it: follow it by hand, turning at each end.
cola_zigzag_cintas.imagen: Footprint of “Zigzag queue of belt posts”: an S of parallel lanes: three lines of belt joined at alternate ends, 4.00 by 3.60 metres, marked with the letters “Cz”.

mostrador_asistencia_pmr.descripcion: Low curved desk at table height, with room to approach seated. This is where you ask to be accompanied to the plane; there are seats beside it for waiting.
mostrador_asistencia_pmr.imagen: Footprint of “Reduced mobility assistance desk”: a curved band bulging towards the front, 2.00 by 1.10 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

contenedor_liquidos_control.descripcion: Large drum with a wide mouth on top, just before security: bottles and anything not allowed through go in it. It sounds of hollow plastic.
contenedor_liquidos_control.imagen: Footprint of “Security liquids bin”: a circle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Cl”.

pila_bandejas_control.descripcion: Plastic trays stacked on a low dolly at the start of the belt. Take the top one. The stack grows and shrinks, and the dolly rolls.
pila_bandejas_control.imagen: Footprint of “Stack of security trays”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.65 metres, marked with the letters “Pb”.

cinta_rodillos_control.descripcion: Long table of metal rollers at hip height. Put your tray on it and push: it rolls on towards the scanner. Follow it by hand as far as the arch.

acciones.dejar_bandeja: Put your things in a tray

cinta_rodillos_control.imagen: Footprint of “Security roller conveyor (section)”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cr”.

tunel_rayos_x.descripcion: Large metal box with the belt running through it. Trays go in and out pushing aside curtains of rubber strips. It hums constantly: use it to locate the checkpoint.
tunel_rayos_x.imagen: Footprint of “X-ray scanner with curtains”: a rectangle with cut corners, 1.00 by 2.20 metres, marked with the letters “Tr”.

arco_detector_metales.descripcion: Narrow frame the size of a doorway, with a panel on each side. Walk through slowly without touching; if you are carrying metal, it beeps.
arco_detector_metales.aviso: Metal detector: walk through slowly without touching the sides.
arco_detector_metales.imagen: Footprint of “Walk-through metal detector”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ad”.

escaner_corporal.descripcion: Round booth of curved glass panels, with an opening. Step in, put your feet on the floor marks and your arms up, and wait for the beep.
escaner_corporal.imagen: Footprint of “Body scanner”: a ring with an opening at the front, 1.70 by 1.70 metres, marked with the letters “Ec”.

mesa_recogida_control.descripcion: Smooth metal table after the scanner, where you collect your things from the tray unhurriedly. It has a raised edge and, underneath, a shelf for empty trays.
mesa_recogida_control.imagen: Footprint of “Repacking table after security”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Mr”.

banco_calzarse_control.descripcion: Low backless bench at the end of security, to sit and put your shoes and belt back on. It is metal and cold.
banco_calzarse_control.imagen: Footprint of “Shoe bench after security”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 1.50 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

cabina_registro_control.descripcion: Panelled cubicle beside the checkpoint, closed at the front by a curtain. Private searches take place inside; there is a chair and a small table.
cabina_registro_control.imagen: Footprint of “Curtained search cubicle”: a U open at the front, 1.50 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Cr”.

cabina_pasaportes.descripcion: Tall glass booth with a police officer inside, seated higher than you. It has a ledge at chest height where you place your passport. You pass alongside it.
cabina_pasaportes.imagen: Footprint of “Passport control booth”: a rectangle with cut corners, 1.50 by 2.20 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

puerta_fronteras_automatica.descripcion: Narrow corridor between two bodies, with glass leaves at the far end. Place your passport on the reader, face forward and, when it beeps, the leaves open.
puerta_fronteras_automatica.imagen: Footprint of “Automatic border control gate”: two narrow bodies at the sides and, between them, thin leaves barring the way, 1.00 by 2.20 metres, marked with the letters “Pf”.

canal_aduana.descripcion: Customs exit corridor: a long screen on one side and, against it, a metal table where you may be asked to open your case. Go through following the screen.
canal_aduana.imagen: Footprint of “Customs channel with inspection table”: an L shape, 3.00 by 4.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

bancada_embarque.descripcion: Row of joined padded seats, with a small table with sockets every two or three places. They are set in facing rows, with a narrow aisle full of bags and feet.
bancada_embarque.imagen: Footprint of “Departure gate seating”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Be”.

tumbona_aeropuerto.descripcion: Long, wave-shaped seat for lying back while you wait, with your feet up. It is longer than you expect: feet stick out into the aisle.
tumbona_aeropuerto.imagen: Footprint of “Airport recliner”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.70 by 1.70 metres, marked with the letters “Ta”.

barra_trabajo_enchufes.descripcion: High narrow counter at elbow height, with sockets at intervals and stools fixed to the floor. People work standing or perched, with cables dangling.
barra_trabajo_enchufes.imagen: Footprint of “Work bar with sockets”: a rectangle, 2.40 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Bt”.

zona_juegos_aeropuerto.descripcion: A ring enclosed by a low, soft wall with one entrance. Inside the floor is rubber and children run and shout: you hear it from a distance.
zona_juegos_aeropuerto.imagen: Footprint of “Airport children's play area”: a ring with an opening at the front, 4.00 by 4.00 metres, marked with the letters “Zj”.

papelera_reciclaje_aeropuerto.descripcion: Long metal unit with three openings on top, each a different shape: round, slot and square. You can tell them apart by touch.
papelera_reciclaje_aeropuerto.imagen: Footprint of “Three-slot airport recycling bin”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Pr”.

pasillo_rodante.descripcion: Metal belt in the floor that carries you along without walking, between two handrails that also move. The floor changes abruptly as you get on and off: step firmly.
pasillo_rodante.aviso: Moving walkway: the floor moves. Hold the handrail.
pasillo_rodante.imagen: Footprint of “Moving walkway (section)”: a rectangle, 1.40 by 6.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pr”.

buggy_asistencia.descripcion: Open electric cart that carries passengers through the terminal. Its motor is almost silent but it beeps as it moves: if you hear the beep, stop and let it pass.
buggy_asistencia.imagen: Footprint of “Electric assistance buggy”: the outline of a vehicle, nose at the front, 1.30 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ba”.

mostrador_puerta_embarque.descripcion: Small desk beside the gate, with a reader that beeps when you scan your boarding pass. Two queues form in front; that gate's announcements come from here.
mostrador_puerta_embarque.imagen: Footprint of “Boarding gate desk”: a rectangle, 1.60 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Mp”.

puerta_pasarela_embarque.descripcion: Sheet-metal door behind the gate desk. It stays shut until boarding starts; beyond it the jet bridge begins, sloping down to the aircraft.
puerta_pasarela_embarque.imagen: Footprint of “Jet bridge door”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.10 metres, marked with the letters “Pp”.

pasarela_avion_tramo.descripcion: Narrow tunnel from the gate to the aircraft. The floor slopes down, sounds hollow and shakes with footsteps; there is a ridge at each joint.
pasarela_avion_tramo.aviso: Jet bridge: the floor slopes down.
pasarela_avion_tramo.imagen: Footprint of “Jet bridge (section)”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 6.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

escalerilla_avion.descripcion: Wheeled metal staircase pushed up against the aircraft on the apron. It has a handrail on each side and steps that ring hollow; there is a landing at the top.
escalerilla_avion.imagen: Footprint of “Aircraft boarding stairs”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 2.00 by 6.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ea”.

cinta_recogida_ovalada.descripcion: Long, low island ringed by a belt of slats that turns non-stop with the cases on it. It is at knee height. It rumbles and clacks: you hear it across the whole hall.
cinta_recogida_ovalada.imagen: Footprint of “Oval baggage carousel”: an elongated oval with straight sides and round ends, 6.00 by 2.50 metres, marked with the letters “Cr”.

cinta_recogida_tramo.descripcion: Straight section of low baggage belt, at knee height. Use it to build a long belt by joining several sections and bends. It rumbles and clacks.
cinta_recogida_tramo.imagen: Footprint of “Baggage belt (straight section)”: a rectangle, 4.00 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Cr”.

cinta_recogida_curva.descripcion: A half-turn of baggage belt: it joins two straight sections. On the bend the slats fan out and are noisier; cases overhang the outer edge.
cinta_recogida_curva.imagen: Footprint of “Baggage belt (bend)”: a curved band bulging towards the front, 3.20 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cr”.

mostrador_equipajes_perdidos.descripcion: Desk in a corner of the reclaim hall, with a low section on the right. Behind it cases are piled up; in front, hurried and cross people.
mostrador_equipajes_perdidos.imagen: Footprint of “Lost baggage desk”: a rectangle whose right-hand section sticks out less: the low section, with knee space, 2.40 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Me”.

puertas_antirretorno_llegadas.descripcion: Automatic glass doors through which you leave baggage reclaim. They open one way only: once out, you cannot go back in.
puertas_antirretorno_llegadas.imagen: Footprint of “One-way arrivals exit doors”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.15 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

barandilla_espera_llegadas.descripcion: Curved railing facing the arrivals door. The people waiting crowd behind it with signs and shouts; those arriving leave round the sides.
barandilla_espera_llegadas.imagen: Footprint of “Arrivals waiting rail”: a curved band bulging towards the front, 5.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Be”.

totem_punto_encuentro.nombre: Meeting point totem with audible beacon
totem_punto_encuentro.descripcion: Tall flat column marking the meeting point. It gives out a soft audible pulse so you can find it; at hand height it carries a braille label.
totem_punto_encuentro.imagen: Footprint of “Meeting point totem with audible beacon”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Tp”.

fila_taxis_barandillas.descripcion: Narrow lane between two long railings on the arrivals pavement. You enter at one end and move up to the other, where the taxis pull in one at a time.
fila_taxis_barandillas.imagen: Footprint of “Railed taxi queue lane”: a U open at the front, 1.40 by 6.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ft”.

bordillo_llegadas.descripcion: The edge of the arrivals pavement. On the other side taxis and shuttle buses stop with engines running, and boots swing open: do not step down until your vehicle is in front of you.
bordillo_llegadas.aviso: Arrivals kerb: taxis and buses stop on the other side.
bordillo_llegadas.imagen: Footprint of “Arrivals kerb”: a rectangle, 10.00 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Bl”.

borde_muelle.descripcion: The rim of the quay: a row of large stones and then nothing. Below is the water, lapping. There is no railing and no warning strip.
borde_muelle.aviso: Quay edge: stop. The water is beyond.
borde_muelle.imagen: Footprint of “Unfenced quay edge”: a rectangle, 10.00 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Bm”.

noray.descripcion: Solid iron mushroom at the quay edge, at shin height, where ships tie up. Low and extremely hard: easy to trip over.
noray.imagen: Footprint of “Mooring bollard”: a circle, 0.40 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “No”.

cabo_amarre_tendido.descripcion: Thick, taut rope running from the bollard to the ship, crossing the quay at shin height. It creaks as it tightens and rises and falls with the ship.
cabo_amarre_tendido.imagen: Footprint of “Taut mooring line”: a rectangle, 0.08 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

argolla_amarre.descripcion: Iron ring the size of a plate, lying flat on the quay. It rises very little, but just enough to catch a toe or the cane tip.
argolla_amarre.imagen: Footprint of “Mooring ring in the ground”: a circle, 0.25 by 0.25 metres, marked with the letters “Aa”.

defensas_muelle.descripcion: A pile of boat fenders: long rubber balloons and old tyres. Soft and springy to the touch; it rolls a little if pushed.
defensas_muelle.imagen: Footprint of “Fenders piled on the quay”: an oval, 1.20 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Dm”.

escala_muelle.descripcion: Two curved tubular rails rising at the quay edge: the handrails of an iron ladder going down to the water. There is a gap between them.
escala_muelle.imagen: Footprint of “Quay ladder”: a U open at the front, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Em”.

base_grua_puerto.descripcion: Huge steel pedestal of a quayside crane, the size of a room. The jib turns overhead and a siren sometimes sounds: never walk under the load.
base_grua_puerto.imagen: Footprint of “Harbour crane base”: an octagon, 3.00 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Bg”.

pasarela_embarque_barco.descripcion: Narrow bridge with rope or tube rails, from the quay to the ship. Its slope changes with the tide and it all moves a little: hold on with both hands.
pasarela_embarque_barco.aviso: Gangway: it slopes and moves. Hold on.
pasarela_embarque_barco.imagen: Footprint of “Ship's gangway”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 6.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pe”.

pantalan_flotante.descripcion: Walkway of planks floating on the water. It dips a little underfoot, rocks, and has water on both sides with no railing. The moorings creak.
pantalan_flotante.aviso: Floating pontoon: it moves and there is water on both sides.
pantalan_flotante.imagen: Footprint of “Floating pontoon (section)”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 8.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pf”.

torreta_pantalan.descripcion: Low plastic pedestal with a tap and sockets, at the pontoon edge. Hoses and cables run from it to the boats, across the walkway.
torreta_pantalan.imagen: Footprint of “Pontoon service pedestal”: a hexagon, 0.30 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Tp”.

rampa_embarque_vehiculos.descripcion: Huge steel ramp along which cars drive onto the ferry. It is ribbed, wet, and booms when a lorry crosses. Foot passengers do not board this way.
rampa_embarque_vehiculos.aviso: Ferry vehicle ramp: cars and lorries drive here.
rampa_embarque_vehiculos.imagen: Footprint of “Vehicle boarding ramp”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 6.00 by 10.00 metres, marked with the letters “Re”.

taquilla_ferris.descripcion: Hut on the quay with a ticket window and a ledge at chest height. An eave juts out at the front to shelter whoever is buying.
taquilla_ferris.imagen: Footprint of “Ferry ticket hut”: a house-shaped pentagon, 2.50 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Tf”.

carro_jaula_equipajes_ferri.descripcion: Large wheeled mesh cage where foot passengers leave their cases before boarding. It sounds of wire when touched and gets towed away.
carro_jaula_equipajes_ferri.imagen: Footprint of “Ferry luggage cage trolley”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cj”.

redes_nasas_amontonadas.descripcion: A heap of fishing nets with floats and weights, with trap pots on top. Soft, tangly and smelling of the sea: cane and feet get caught.
redes_nasas_amontonadas.imagen: Footprint of “Piled nets and pots”: an oval, 2.50 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Rn”.

cajas_pescado_lonja.descripcion: A stack of plastic boxes with ice and fish, or empty. The floor round them is wet and slippery; the stacks move about all the time.
cajas_pescado_lonja.imagen: Footprint of “Stacked fish boxes”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

bascula_lonja.descripcion: Metal platform at floor level with a column behind it carrying the display. You step on it unawares: it sounds hollow and gives slightly. It beeps when weighing.
bascula_lonja.imagen: Footprint of “Fish market scale”: a T shape, 1.00 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Bl”.

carretilla_mano_lonja.descripcion: Two-wheeled hand truck with a toe plate at the bottom, standing upright or loaded with boxes. It falls over with a crash if knocked.
carretilla_mano_lonja.imagen: Footprint of “Fish market hand truck”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Cm”.
